definitions: The part of the internet that is not indexed by search engines and requires specific software, configurations, or authorization to access.
A hidden collective of internet sites only accessible with a specialized web browser.
examples: He found the stolen data circulating on the dark web.
Accessing the dark web often involves using Tor.
The dark web is known for both illicit activities and privacy-focused communication.
synonyms: deep web (often used interchangeably, though technically distinct)
